svg.aria-label: B-15N · BOARD LAYOUT (DERIVED) — redrawn board layout diagram, layout-sheet drafting style
svg.text: Redrawn from Ampeg factory schematic, engineering issue, title block "B-15-N / U.S. PATENT 3183305 / TUBES / 6SL7 - 6SL7 - 6SL7 - 6L6GC - 6L6GC - 5AR4 / -472-", PART NO. 591722, revision C of 1/22/74 — layout DERIVED from that circuit drawing; Ampeg published no board-layout sheet for this chassis and none was located — not a trace

Heater layer: no factory board-layout drawing exists for this amplifier, so its heater wiring cannot be read off one. The valves on the chain are this circuit's own; the order the chain reaches them in is this drawing's convention.
Note: the 6.3 V heater twisted pair always routes on the top layer and never joins another run — its crossings are not hop-overs.
green — the 6.3 V heater line's tails to the VR7 hum balance
